svg.text: silent-link: T0-T1 link a1-s11 drops everything (carrier stays up)
Replay of a real lab run at real time (line thickness = packets delivered on that path; dashes move when traffic flows). Planes: a1/b1 + s11/s12 = plane 1, a2/b2 + s21/s22 = plane 2.

g.text: BGP + ECMP fabric - one single-path flow (RoCE-style)
FAULT injected - BGP still believes the path is fine: nothing is delivered
BGP hold timer expires after 2270 ms; flow rerouted via s12
MRC fabric - static uSID, no BGP - one flow sprayed over 8 EVs
FAULT injected - endpoint still sending on all paths
Sender retires the bad EVs after 19 ms; traffic stays on good paths
REPAIRED - probes succeed, EVs back after 82 ms
